steps.en: Install the package next to an already installed Chrome
steps.zh: 在已装好 Chrome 的机器上安装这个包

steps.en: Swap Selenium's Chrome class for this one
steps.zh: 把 Selenium 的 Chrome 类换成它的

steps.en: Downloads chromedriver and blanks out the marker-injecting block inside the binary
steps.zh: 下载 chromedriver，把二进制里注入标记的那段代码抹掉

steps.en: Starts your Chrome itself with a temporary profile, then attaches Selenium to it
steps.zh: 用临时 profile 自行拉起 Chrome，再让 Selenium 接上

steps.en: Keep calling the ordinary Selenium API
steps.zh: 照旧调用普通的 Selenium API

value.en: An existing Selenium script keeps its code and loses chromedriver's own giveaway markers — your IP reputation is still yours to fix
value.zh: 现有 Selenium 脚本不用改写，就去掉了 chromedriver 自带的暴露标记——IP 信誉仍归你管

sources: README.md 'What this is not' + Usage > easy (import undetected_chromedriver as uc; driver = uc.Chrome(); driver.get('https://nowsecure.nl'))
undetected_chromedriver/patcher.py (auto(): fetch_release_number/fetch_package from chrome-for-testing, patch_exe() replaces the {window.cdc...} block)
undetected_chromedriver/__init__.py (tempfile.mkdtemp() user-data-dir, --remote-debugging-port, subprocess.Popen/start_detached of the browser, then ChromiumService(self.patcher.executable_path))
example/example.py (ordinary Selenium calls: find_element, WebDriverWait, execute_script on a uc.Chrome() driver)
